competitor_alerts: MARKET SHIFT this week: Kosher Palate (7989 Belt Line Rd) now shows as CLOSED on Yelp — it appeared as an active kosher market/catering/delivery competitor in prior runs. Its closure frees up 'kosher market'/'kosher catering' demand on Belt Line Rd that The Hungry Rooster can target with a landing page or GBP service-area push.
The Market Local Comfort Cafe (13534 Preston Rd) is also now listed CLOSED on Yelp — another North Dallas kosher spot off the board, thinning the field.

NEW ENTRANT: JGourmet at the Aaron Family JCC has opened a new Kosher Dairy Kitchen positioning itself as 'the go-to kosher food & caterer in Dallas.' As a dairy operation with an institutional base (JCC), it competes most directly on Jewish/community catering — the exact term where we rank #2.

Review-count gap persists: Simcha Kosher Catering now shows ~23 reviews (4.3 stars) on Birdeye and 11 on Yelp, plus WeddingWire profiles. A Taste of the World maintains a full public reviews page. The Hungry Rooster still exposes only a /review submission form and no public testimonials — a continuing trust-signal and long-tail gap.

Directories still own discovery: Dallas Kosher (dallaskosher.org) and DOJLife.com surface across nearly every kosher-Dallas query. The Hungry Rooster does not appear listed on either — an unclaimed authoritative backlink and referral source.

Delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Postmates) own essentially every 'kosher delivery Dallas' and 'kosher meal delivery Texas' result; we surface only in AI summaries, not the ranked listings.

summary: The Hungry Rooster holds page-one positions for its two catering terms (#2 for 'Jewish catering Dallas', ~#4 for 'kosher catering Dallas') but remains invisible for food, restaurant, delivery, and Shabbat queries — largely due to fixable on-site issues: the /shabbat page still renders only 'Loading...' to crawlers and every subpage canonicalizes to the homepage. The notable change this week is market movement: Kosher Palate and The Market Local Comfort Cafe both now show CLOSED on Yelp while JGourmet's new dairy kitchen enters the community-catering space. Top priorities are pre-rendering /shabbat, fixing self-canonicalization, and moving quickly to capture the demand freed by the two competitor closures.
